title: Director Sign-off Output (director decision envelope)

decision.description: The director's sign-off decision. Maps 1:1 to the module's two terminal outcomes.

campaignBundleId.description: The scored campaign bundle id the decision applies to. Must match the input bundle id.

decidedBy.description: Identity of the director who recorded the decision (human authority).

decidedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the director-console adapter recorded the decision.

rationale.description: Optional free-text rationale the director attached to the decision.

description: Output contract for the director-signoff Human node: the opaque director decision envelope produced by the director-console adapter. authority: human. The runtime records this envelope as the node-run production.
